The project runs for 36 months (3 years), and the post is temporary and purely contractual. content_sections.heading: IIT Dharwad Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: "Unraveling the mechanistic underpinnings of arginomycin biosynthesis: A remarkable peptidyl-nucleoside natural product with potential therapeutic implications" [CSIR Sanction Reference No. 80 (0135)/26/EMR-II]
Rs. 37,000 per month (1st and 2nd years); Rs. 42,000 (3rd year, upon upgradation to SRF); plus 16% HRA
Department of Chemistry, IIT Dharwad, Dharwad, Karnataka

content_sections.heading: About IIT Dharwad
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad as an Institution of National Importance established by an Act of Parliament in 2016. It is located at Chikkamalligawad, Dharwad, Karnataka – 580 011. This vacancy sits in the Department of Chemistry, and the Principal Investigator named in the notice is Dr. Nilkamal Mahanta.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is as printed in the notice: B.S. 4 years programme (Chemistry/Biochemistry/Biotechnology or relevant discipline)/ B. Pharm/MBBS/ Integrated B.S.-M.S., or M.Sc./BE/B.Tech (or equivalent degree) in Chemistry/ Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Life Sciences or a related discipline, with a minimum of 55% marks. Passing of CSIR-UGC NET [JRF/Lectureship (LS)] or GATE test, as per CSIR guidelines. The qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute. The upper age limit is 28 years for JRF. It is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates. Eligibility in terms of age, qualification and experience is considered as on the date of the Selection Process. The notice does not state a desirable qualification or any required experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: See the full wording below the table; a minimum of 55% marks and a pass in CSIR-UGC NET [JRF/Lectureship (LS)] or GATE are required.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is in a time-bound research project for a temporary period, purely on a contractual basis. The project tenure is 36 months (3 years). Selected candidates have no claim on any regular position. They are not given privileges such as Housing, Medical Facility and other benefits available to regular employees of the Institute.

rows.pay: Rs. 37,000 per month for first and second years, followed by Rs. 42,000 in the 3rd year upon upgradation to SRF + 16% HRA

content_sections.heading: IIT Dharwad Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Biochemical characterization of enzymes involved in natural product biosynthesis. Cloning, expression and purification of proteins. Enzyme assays. Isolation and characterization of compounds using chromatographic, spectroscopic, and mass spectrometric techniques. Data analysis and report preparation. Any other project related duties as assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Dharwad Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested candidates should apply for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position through the online application link given in the notice, by 1 December 2026. The notice does not describe further form-filling steps. Documents named in the notice: Online version of all original certificates, including mark sheets (matriculation onwards). Experience certificate(s). Monthly emoluments/salary drawn. Other relevant documents, including one set of self-attested certificate(s)/document(s). Updated Curriculum Vitae. For queries, candidates may write to [email protected] or [email protected] . For a query related to the Selection Process, applicants may email [email protected] . Queries on eligibility for the post or interpretation of rules will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are first screened for eligibility. Only the shortlisted applicants are called for an interview, which is held online. Mere fulfilment of minimum eligibility does not give the right to shortlisting, and IIT Dharwad reserves the right to screen and shortlist candidates by introducing higher benchmarks. Emails are sent to all shortlisted candidates. The date of the interview/selection process (tentative) will be intimated later through email, and any change in the schedule will be notified on the IIT Dharwad website.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow (JRF) vacancies are there at IIT Dharwad?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) vacancy. The notice calls the number tentative and reserves the right to increase or decrease it at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Dharwad JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Dharwad JRF post?
faq.answer: A B.S. 4 years programme, B. Pharm, MBBS or Integrated B.S.-M.S., or an M.Sc./BE/B.Tech (or equivalent) in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Life Sciences or a related discipline, with at least 55% marks. A pass in CSIR-UGC NET [JRF/Lectureship (LS)] or GATE is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Dharwad JRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the IIT Dharwad JRF post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 per month for the first and second years, followed by Rs. 42,000 in the 3rd year upon upgradation to SRF, plus 16% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the JRF fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints 16% HRA along with the fellowship amounts. It states no other allowance.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Dharwad JRF post?
faq.answer: Apply through the online application form link given in the notice. Candidates should keep the online version of their certificates, one set of self-attested documents and an updated CV ready.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the IIT Dharwad JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications are screened for eligibility, and only shortlisted applicants are called for an online interview. Shortlisted candidates are informed by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIT Dharwad JRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is temporary, purely on a contractual basis, in a 36-month (3 years) research project. Selected candidates have no claim on any regular position.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the Selection Process.
